company.name: Brame
company.description:
BRAME is a software-as-a-service (SaaS) company in martech that offers the leading solution for Gamification Marketing. 

BRAME built the industry's leading drag-and-drop Gamification Builder that enables the creation and implementation of Gamification mechanics and campaigns in zero time and without any programming or design effort.

BRAME's Gamification Builder works similarly to common website builders like Square Space or Wix. Instead of websites, you create Gamification mechanics such as scratch cards, quizzes, hit the target, and many more and personalize them with your desired game flows, rules, and corporate identity.

Gamifying existing initiatives such as sweepstakes, content, promotions, and loyalty programs significantly improves results throughout the customer journey and helps you engage, convert, and retain more customers.

In addition to BRAME's intuitive self-service solution for Gamification Marketing, including customer success enablement from senior Gamification Marketing experts, BRAME offers premium services such as Gamification consulting and managed services.
